item.text: **True.** `SessionBase.cycle_key()` saves the current session data, calls `create()` to generate a new unique key, restores the data, then deletes the old key: [django/contrib/sessions/backends/base.py:298–307](django/contrib/sessions/backends/base.py#L298-L307). The `create()` contract specifies a unique key: [django/contrib/sessions/backends/base.py:319–326](django/contrib/sessions/backends/base.py#L319-L326).
